text: ひとこと　いい　わすれてた！

patterns.name: 〜忘れる
patterns.explanation: わすれる stuck onto the stem of another verb means 'forget to do' it. いい わすれてた = 'I had forgotten to say'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てた is the shortened form of ていた, saying a state had been going on. わすれてた = 'had been forgetting', so 'I'd forgotten'.
